subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the bold part of the sentence.

She has **did** her homework already.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence uses the incorrect verb form "**did**" after "**has**."
 
• In the present perfect tense, the correct verb form is the past participle "**done**."
 
• Additionally, the phrase "**her homeworks**" is grammatically incorrect because "**homework**" is an uncountable noun that should not be pluralized.
 
• Thus, the correct sentence should replace "**did her homework**" with "**done her homework**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"She has done her homework already."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "made homework" **– This is incorrect because "**made**" does not fit the context.
 
• **Option 3: "made her homework"** – This is incorrect because "**made**" does not convey the intended meaning.
 
• **Option 4: "doing her homework"** – This is incorrect because it suggests an ongoing action, whereas the sentence indicates completion.
